properties.statement: OBSERVED on main 293f957: stdio `--graph-path .reflow2/graph --only-if-present --export-to design.json`, reflow2_start_design, then add_project: after 20 s design.json did not exist (the_latent_surface_serves_the_transport_asked_and_prepares_the_design_it_starts failed there). EXPECTED: the write-through the same command line starts for a design opened at once. CAUSE, read in latent.rs: LatentService::promoted opened the store with ReflowService::new_reporting and applied only into_read_only; the preparation the server's healthy start applies (main.rs ServeAs: tree root, provenance note, --export-to, and over HTTP the caller rule) was a second door it never passed — the GitHub #616 fix-4 class (a design served after a wait served differently from one served at once). Fixed in the same change: LatentService::prepared_by takes the server's ServeAs.
